'''Rnthmyr''' was an ancient [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior who lived on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. He was killed in [[3637 BBY]] during the [[Revanite crisis|conflict]] with the [[Order of Revan]].<ref name="Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>
